static_traits.name: Lin Sijie
static_traits.social_status: 有少数亲密朋友知晓其困境，但很少主动寻求帮助；因Social anxiety而避免聚会、难以主动开启对话，影响建立与维持亲密关系及职业网络
static_traits.medical_history: 大学期间被诊断为轻度强迫症（OCD），伴随Anxiety；not yet接受针对Social anxiety或强迫症的专门治疗；without显著躯体疾病
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能够觉察并描述自身的负性思维（如“大家都在评判我”“I am clumsy”）；配合度Good，能接受认知重构的探索；自我批评倾向较强

basic_info.main_problem: In social situations, will 'freeze', feels oneself to be very clumsy, affecting interaction and relationships with others.
basic_info.core_demands: 希望在Social situations感到舒适，not再被Anxiety束缚，能在个人与职业层面建立真实的连接并顺畅开展网络与客户互动。
growth_experiences: 大学时期开始出现Social anxiety，并被诊断为轻度强迫症（OCD）；近两年症状加重，导致在群体场合或When meeting new friends出现“冻结”、避免Social gatherings与难以发起对话；not yet接受针对Social anxiety或强迫症的治疗；尽管Work绩效Good，但职业网络与客户互动受挫，亲密关系形成困难。

special_situations.event: 在一次商务社交/网络活动中进行自我介绍时词not达意
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我在公开场合not能表现得流畅且接近完美，do not人就会认为我without能
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Speaking less, leaving as soon as possible, and avoiding similar activities afterward

special_situations.event: In group settings or when meeting new clients/strangers, tension and 'freezing' appear
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能立刻表现自如，就证明我not适合社交、I am just a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Leaving early and avoiding starting conversations to reduce the chance of being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远without法应付这些场合

special_situations.event: 社交互动中被强迫症trigger，过度担心细微瑕疵被他人注意
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Any small mistake will be magnified and attract negative evaluation
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 过度Self-monitoring与Over-preparation，刻意控制言行或回避暴露自己
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我犯了小错，大家只会看到这些缺点并觉得我not专业

special_situations.event: When recalling past times when several social conversations went smoothly
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not是每次都表现出色，那些正面经历就not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate正面经验、继续以负面标签定义自己
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 那些成功只是偶然，not代表我能做好

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and build genuine connections
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被他人评判与negate，担心被视为without能或笨拙
defense_goal: 通过回避群体场合与ReinforcementSelf-monitoring来降低被negate的风险
not向他人求助以避免成为负担

object_relations.object_representation: Others/groups who are critical and ready to judge me at any time

object_relations.self_representation: not应给do not人添麻烦的个体
object_relations.object_representation: Friends / others who may be 'dragged down' by her

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When needing to introduce self in a group setting or being watched by many people
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 他人正在审视并negate我（把内在的严苛评判Projection到他人身上）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use防御性语气与绝对化措辞（如“大家都觉得……”），缩短互动、尽快结束谈话或寻找离场理由。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking of seeking help from friends or when others offer support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 如果求助会成为负担，do not人可能not愿意或会看轻我
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以委婉但坚定的方式拒绝他人帮助，反复强调“我not该麻烦do not人”，回避进一步探讨支持的具体方式。

manifestations: In social settings she 'freezes' and avoids gatherings, finds it hard to initiate conversation, and often leaves social settings alone
虽有亲密朋友知晓其困境，但not主动寻求他们的帮助以免成为负担
outcomes: Reduced interpersonal connection; difficulty forming intimate relationships
Limited professional network; interaction with clients affected

contact_model.definition: 个体存在not良的自我Reflection与过度自我限制、自我苛责，对接触过于小心谨慎。
manifestations: High self-consciousness and tension in socializing, paying excessive attention to whether minor mistakes are noticed by others
Deliberately controls words and actions to avoid mistakes, leading to 'freezing' and difficulty speaking

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: 认为“大家都在评判我”“他们觉得我not称职”，将内在批判体验归因于外界他人

contact_model.definition: 个体将原欲对外发出的能量转而对自己，克制向外寻求do not人为其做某事的冲动。
manifestations: not向朋友寻求支持，选择独自承受Anxiety与强迫困扰
以“not该麻烦do not人”为由Repression求助行为

positive_force: 主动寻求心理咨询与改变，具备自我觉察（能识do not并愿意挑战负性思维）
Work performance stable, with professional competence and a sense of responsibility
Has several close friends who know his predicament, a potential support resource
Has had a few experiences of smooth social conversations, which can serve as positive references
negative_force: 在群体场合及When meeting new friends倾向回避与提前退出，维护短期安全感却维持问题
存在读心术、过度概括、心理过滤、negate正面等认知偏差
轻度强迫症使其过度关注细微错误，进一步加剧Social anxiety
自我标签（“笨拙”“not称职”）并negate正面经验，削弱Self-efficacy
担心成为负担而not寻求支持，导致资源not yet被激活

target_behavior.behavior: In social settings, 'freezes' and avoids interaction
target_behavior.core_reason: 灾难化与过度概括的认知（担心被全面negate），加之强迫症导致对细微错误的过度关注，ReinforcementSelf-monitoring与紧张
target_behavior.function: 逃避被评判与negate以降低即时Anxiety，获得短期安全感
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal relationships与职业网络受损，客户互动受影响；感到Loneliness并Decreased sense of self-worth

target_behavior.behavior: not向朋友或他人寻求帮助与支持
antecedent: When thinking about seeking support from others
When friends know their plight and offer help
target_behavior.core_reason: Worries about becoming a burden and being looked down on; magnifies potential negative outcomes to avoid seeking help
target_behavior.function: Avoids guilt and possible rejection, maintaining a sense of control over relationship risks
target_behavior.consequence: 支持系统not yet被激活，问题维持且Increased sense of isolation
